stem: Which sentence from the selection best matches the feeling expressed by the speaker in line 14 of the poem?
instruction:
Read line 14 from the poem.

Soon I'd be a rich young man.

options.label: F
options.text: The Tlingit, people native to the area, offered their services as guides.

options.label: G
options.text: One city that was drastically changed by the discovery of gold in the Yukon was Seattle, Washington.

options.label: H
options.text: News of the gold find gave people hope.

options.label: J
options.text: Before the gold rush was over, Mulroney had opened several restaurants and hotels in Dawson.

visual_elements: Soon I'd be a rich young man.
